Satisfactory Performance certificate issued by respective Buyer Organization for the above Orders should be uploaded with bid. The Bidder shall be either an authorized Supplier or an Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) of UPS sys tems and must have been in existence and operating in India for a minimum period of three (3) years as of 31/03/2026. (A certified cop y of the Certificate of Incorporation shall be submitted as mandatory proof.) 2. The Bidder/OEM shall submit documentary evidence demonstrating the satisfactory commissioning of a q uantity of UPS systems (of 3 kVA or higher capacity) equal to at least twice the quoted quantity within the l ast three (3) financial years (2023– 2026) to Banks, Financial Institutions, or Government Organizations in India. (Copies of relevant purchase orders along with satisfactory performance certificates issued by said o rganizations shall be submitted.) 3. The Bidder shall not stand debarred or blacklisted by any Government Department, Regulatory Agency, P ublic Sector Undertaking (PSU), or Banking Institution at the time of bid submission. Furthermore, the Bidd er shall not be insolvent or bankrupt at the time of submission. (A Self-Declaration executed strictly as per the format pr escribed in Annexure-II shall be attached.) 4. The OEM shall maintain at least Four (4) operational Service Centres within the specified districts of Bihar coming under the jurisdiction of the Zonal Office Gaya (namely: Gaya, Nawada, Nalanda, Jehanabad, Lakhi sarai, Kaimur, Aurangabad, Rohtas, Arwal, Sheikhpura,). Out of these, one (1) Service Centre must be located within the district of Gaya. These centres must have been fully operational for the last five (5) years, and valid proof of existence shall be submitted. Each desi gnated Service Centre must employ a minimum of two ( 2) qualified engineers. A comprehensive list of the se service centres, detailing their complete postal addresses, shall be submitted on the OEM’s official lette rhead along with proof of address. The address of any third-party support partner shall not be accepted.

5. The OEM shall possess a continuous operational track record in India of not less than ten (10) years, supp orted by verifiable documentary proof. The OEM shall submit PEP & REACH certificates, or equivalent certif ications, issued by a Central Government-approved laboratory. 6. The Bidder shall submit a formal Service Escalation Matrix on the OEM’s official letterhead, duly bearing t he Bid Number, Date, Authorized Signature, and Company Seal. 7. The Bidder shall strictly comply with all additional terms and conditions stipulated under Section-I of the b uyer-uploaded ATC document. 8. The Bidder shall execute and submit the Bid Form (Annexure-I) and the self declaration concerning non-bl acklisting (Annexure-II) strictly in accordance with the formats enclosed under Section-II of the buyer-uploa ded ATC document. 9. The Bidder shall submit a formal Warranty Declaration on the OEM's official letterhead, explicitly specifyin g the Bid Number, Date, Authorized Signature, and Company Seal. 10. The OEM shall possess a valid Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) Certificate, and the manufacturing facility address registered in the BIS certificate must exactly match the physical factory location. 11. The Bidder shall submit a comprehensive Product Compliance Sheet on the OEM’s official letterhead, com plete with the Bid Number, Date, Authorized Signature, and Company Seal. 12. The Bidder must maintain a legally registered office within the state of Bihar and shall submit a valid GST Registration Certificate as proof of establishment. 13. The installation and commissioning of the UPS systems and batteries shall be executed entirely free of cos t by a certified technical engineer designated by the Bidder/OEM. . 10. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Banker’s Cheque in favour of INDIAN BANK ZONAL OFFICE GAYA payable at GAYA . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the BC along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 11.
